reason: The hypothesis relies on W-induced tribolayer formation in CoCrFeNi, but the cited evidence (E3, E4) is for AlCoCrFeNiWx coatings on steel, not bulk CoCrFeNi, and reports fluctuating friction. E2 provides a general friction model for CoCrFeMnNi, not W-doped CoCrFeNi, and E1 describes oxidation wear in other HEAs without W. None of the cited passages directly support the key premise that a small W addition to CoCrFeNi forms a stable, lubricious tribolayer across the full temperature range.
premises: W addition to AlCoCrFeNi coatings reduces friction and wear at 800 °C
W addition causes lattice distortion and forms W-rich intermetallic compounds
Grain size-dependent shear strength model explains low friction in HEAs
CoCrFeMnNi and AlxCoCrFeNi show oxidation-dominated wear above 600 °C
